# Introduction

The Cauldron is a crafting station used to prepare food. It requires a fire source underneath to operate, such as a Campfire or Hearth.

## Building

Cauldrons can be placed using the Hammer, found under the Crafting tab. A fire does not need to be present to place a Cauldron, only to use/craft with it.
The Cauldron recipe is unlocked only when the player picks up Tin for the first time after smelting it and has a Forge built.

## Upgrades

Upgrading a Cauldron enables additional crafting recipes. A Cauldron can be upgraded up to level 6 by building the following structures near it:

• Name: Spice rack | Materials: 3 Dandelion 2 Carrot 5 Mushroom 3 Thistle 3 Turnip

• Name: Butcher's table | Materials: 2 Ancient bark 4 Corewood 4 Finewood 2 Silver

• Name: Pots and pans | Materials: 5 Iron 5 Copper 5 Black metal 10 Finewood

• Name: Mortar and pestle | Materials: 8 Black marble 6 Finewood 4 Corewood

• Name: Rolling pins and cutting boards | Materials: 8 Ashwood 6 Finewood 4 Flametal
